title: Tamil 'மண்டலம் 5' is ignored: the screen shows all of Chennai
what_happens: 'மண்டலம் 5 கடுமையான புகார்கள் காட்டு' opens 'Severe cases · today' with 8 cases for the whole city (zone 5 has 2), and says it with no hint the zone was dropped. The same sentence in English gives Royapuram, 2 cases. Same for 'மண்டலம் 5-ல் ...' and 'மண்டலம் ஐந்து ...'.
what_should_happen: The screen is scoped to zone 5 (Royapuram), as in English.
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main; npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-jarvis2.test.ts (remove it.fails to see the failure); test jarvis2-1

title: 'open the last one' / 'draft the last one' / Tamil 'கடைசியாக உள்ளதை திற' are not understood
what_happens: ORD has last: -1 but every caller needs n > 0, so 'last' never works. With no model it answers 'I cannot reason right now'.
what_should_happen: Open or draft the last case.

title: 'draft it' with a case open on the Stage asks 'Draft for which incident?'
what_happens: Opening a case from the Stage sets only the Stage focus, not the console's incident, so 'draft it', 'draft this' and 'draft it for me' ask which one (the Stage case is the obvious one). Tamil 'அதை வரைவு செய்' fails the same way. A model may cover this; the no-model path does not.
what_should_happen: Draft the open case into the tray.
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main; npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-jarvis2.test.ts (remove it.fails to see the failure); test jarvis2-9
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/stagelocal.ts:74 (draft needs an ordinal) and Thunai.tsx state() sends no focused case

repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main; npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-jarvis2.test.ts (remove it.fails to see the failure); test jarvis2-10
